detailed_descriptions.en: A TALE OF TOGETHERNESS IN A WORLD APART After a failed ritual to elevate the world’s Champions and grant them miracles capable of improving the world, a mist of loneliness and despair sweeps the land of Etere... A glimmer of hope materialises as Ghost, a spirit who wakes to find they hold no memories. It’s time to embark on a heroic adventure and gather those who can restore balance and help you discover your past in this charming and emotional tale. It’s time to start a new chapter together! JOURNEY TO CATHARSIS Relationships are the heart and soul of The Lonesome Guild – it’s a party, literally. And a party can only be strong if each member is strong too – build deep bonds and help your new friends find their inner strength through the conflicts they face. Your ragtag group of 6 unlikely friends will bring their own story and struggles. Switch seamlessly between them in battle and exploration, unlock side quests and new abilities, and have heartfelt chats by the campfire. FIGHTS THAT KEEP YOU ON YOUR TOES Ghost ‘joins’ with our heroes in battle, making them stronger. Test your might in intense battles where you can switch between characters whenever you fancy and ambush enemies with clever combos. Build your dream team to match your playstyle, create cool and unique synergies between heroes, and fight your way through Etere together. A WORLD WORTH FIGHTING FOR Etere is an enchanted hand-painted world full of charm and secrets, inhabited by ancient cultures and living legends across five distinct regions. Solve puzzles and unearth old secrets as a team to overcome obstacles nobody could face alone. You can find many shiny objects – gifts for your friends, artifacts to help, and loot that enhance your party’s fighting prowess. The world might be lonely, but you don’t have to be.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A TALE OF TOGETHERNESS IN A WORLD APART 

After a failed ritual to elevate the world’s Champions and grant them miracles capable of improving the world, a mist of loneliness and despair sweeps the land of Etere... 

A glimmer of hope materialises as Ghost, a spirit who wakes to find they hold no memories. It’s time to embark on a heroic adventure and gather those who can restore balance and help you discover your past in this charming and emotional tale. It’s time to start a new chapter together!

JOURNEY TO CATHARSIS

Relationships are the heart and soul of The Lonesome Guild – it’s a party, literally. And a party can only be strong if each member is strong too – build deep bonds and help your new friends find their inner strength through the conflicts they face. Your ragtag group of 6 unlikely friends will bring their own story and struggles. Switch seamlessly between them in battle and exploration, unlock side quests and new abilities, and have heartfelt chats by the campfire. 

FIGHTS THAT KEEP YOU ON YOUR TOES

Ghost ‘joins’ with our heroes in battle, making them stronger. Test your might in intense battles where you can switch between characters whenever you fancy and ambush enemies with clever combos. Build your dream team to match your playstyle, create cool and unique synergies between heroes, and fight your way through Etere together. 

A WORLD WORTH FIGHTING FOR

Etere is an enchanted hand-painted world full of charm and secrets, inhabited by ancient cultures and living legends across five distinct regions. Solve puzzles and unearth old secrets as a team to overcome obstacles nobody could face alone. You can find many shiny objects – gifts for your friends, artifacts to help, and loot that enhance your party’s fighting prowess. 

The world might be lonely, but you don’t have to be.
